segments.caption: Where now, unlucky man, alone through these hills and knowing nothing of the ground? Your friends are penned as pigs in Circe's sties — and you march straight in to join them.

segments.speaker: hermes-as-young-man
segments.caption: Here — take this herb of power and carry it against her drugs. The gods call it moly: black at the root, its flower white as milk. Hard for mortal men to dig, but the gods can do all things.
segments.delivery: derive from current embodied condition and relationship pressure

segments.speaker: hermes-as-young-man
segments.caption: When she strikes you with her wand, draw your sword and rush her as if to kill. And before you go to her bed, make her swear the great oath of the gods that she plots no further harm — lest she strip you naked and unman you.
